items.grounds: Re-derived from bytes both ways. The shipped rival ground 'share no skeleton token with this verse' is true for 25:15 and byte-false for 25:17: the word-bound skeleton-token intersection oshb:Prov.25.15|oshb:Prov.25.16 is 0 tokens, oshb:Prov.25.16|oshb:Prov.25.17 is 1 token, the lest-particle, byte-identical at the byte tier as פֶּן (oshb:Prov.25.16) and פֶּן (oshb:Prov.25.17). The auditor's root and construction claims hold with one count-object correction: the sin-dotted satisfied-sense root (skeleton שבע, sin-dotted forms only; the shin-dotted seven/swear homograph is a separate 6-verse object) stands in 19 verses book-wide (sweep, verses), here as תִּ֝שְׂבָּעֶ֗נּוּ (oshb:Prov.25.16) and יִ֝שְׂבָּעֲךָ֗ (oshb:Prov.25.17), both byte tier; the lest-particle immediately followed by a yiqtol of that root stands in exactly 4 verses (sweep, verses: Prov.5.10, Prov.25.16, Prov.25.17, Prov.30.9), but the auditor's label 'pen-plus-suffixed-yiqtol' fits only 2 of the 4, because פֶּֽן יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ (oshb:Prov.5.10) is an unsuffixed plural and פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע (oshb:Prov.30.9) an unsuffixed first person, so the object-suffixed form of the construction is confined to this seam's two verses, which are also the only adjacent pair of the 4; the correction narrows the object and strengthens the finding. The whole frame is shared: imperative אֱכֹ֣ל (oshb:Prov.25.16) / הֹקַ֣ר (oshb:Prov.25.17), then the lest-particle plus the suffixed yiqtol, then a suffixed consequence verb וַהֲקֵֽאתֽוֹ (oshb:Prov.25.16) / וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ (oshb:Prov.25.17), all byte tier. BOTH SIDES of the seam the rival concerns, 25:16|25:17: the closing verse דְּבַ֣שׁ מָ֭צָאתָ אֱכֹ֣ל דַּיֶּ֑ךָּ פֶּן תִּ֝שְׂבָּעֶ֗נּוּ וַהֲקֵֽאתֽוֹ (oshb:Prov.25.16) and the opening verse הֹקַ֣ר רַ֭גְלְךָ מִבֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ פֶּן יִ֝שְׂבָּעֲךָ֗ וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ (oshb:Prov.25.17), both byte tier; under the book's governing rule (C5 single-proverb default; a cluster only on named byte-grounded cohesion such as a pair grouping or a shared construction run) the shared construction is exactly a named warrant class, while each verse remains a syntactically complete admonition opened by its own imperative, so the rule permits the pair and does not compel it. The outer seams of the proposed pair are clean at both edges: oshb:Prov.25.15|oshb:Prov.25.16 shares 0 tokens (25:15 closes on the observation בְּאֹ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם יְפֻתֶּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְלָשׁ֥וֹן רַ֝כָּ֗ה תִּשְׁבָּר גָּֽרֶם (oshb:Prov.25.15), byte tier) and oshb:Prov.25.17|oshb:Prov.25.18 shares 0 tokens (25:18 opens a new simile, מֵפִ֣יץ וְ֭חֶרֶב וְחֵ֣ץ שָׁנ֑וּן אִ֥ישׁ עֹנֶ֥ה בְ֝רֵעֵ֗הוּ עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר (oshb:Prov.25.18), byte tier; the neighbour-word echo רֵעֶ֑ךָ (oshb:Prov.25.17) / בְ֝רֵעֵ֗הוּ (oshb:Prov.25.18) is root-level only, no shared token, and carries none of the construction). The auditor's comparison to the shipped pair Prov.25.11-Prov.25.12 is byte-true: oshb:Prov.25.11|oshb:Prov.25.12 shares 2 tokens, זָ֭הָב (oshb:Prov.25.11) / זָ֭הָב (oshb:Prov.25.12) byte-identical plus the particle על (skeleton-tier mention), i.e. 1 content token plus adjacency, thinner than this seam's token plus root plus construction. Severity: the false sentence is the entire stated warrant for rejecting the strongest rival, the straddling device is undisclosed in every field of the row, and confidence high rests on it, so the defect is load-bearing and high is confirmed. Adjacent-row coherence: the 25:17 row (M8-Prov-438) discloses only the root at its broad 19-verse object and calls it too frequent to bound a unit, which is true of the root and silent on the shared lest-particle token and the 2-verse suffixed construction; whichever arm is adopted must be applied to that row coherently (retired under arm b, or its disclosure completed under arm a). Span ruling endorse_proposal: the respan Prov.25.16-Prov.25.17 as one proverb_cluster is byte-sound under the owner gate's own construction-run warrant and rests on more than the shipped 25:4-5 and 25:11-12 pairs; arm a (atomic rows retained, dead warrant replaced, device disclosed) is also byte-compliant because the default is atomic and each verse is complete, so the choice between the arms is owner triage, and a replacement warrant under arm a passes the test that killed the original only if it names the shared lest-particle token, the suffixed-yiqtol construction and its 2-verse book-wide count and argues the atomic default over them. Nothing is adopted here; both arms remain proposals for the owner docket.

Re-derived from bytes both ways. The row's own site is byte-true: the inline unpointed ketiv מדונים (oshb:Prov.27.15) precedes the pointed qere מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים (oshb:Prov.27.15), both byte tier, and pmarks_Prov.json kq records 1 note at Prov.27.15 (single witness). The auditor's book-wide digits re-derive exactly: the ketiv skeleton מדונים (skeleton-tier mention) stands in 6 verses (sweep, contiguous skeleton substring, verses: Prov.18.19, Prov.21.19, Prov.23.29, Prov.25.24, Prov.26.21, Prov.27.15), as the bare token in 5 and waw-prefixed in 1 (ומדונים at oshb:Prov.18.19, byte tier), with a kq note at every one of the 6; the two-token ketiv-plus-qere run is byte-identical at exactly 3 sites, מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים (oshb:Prov.25.24), מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים (oshb:Prov.26.21) and מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים (oshb:Prov.27.15), while the qere differs by accent only at מִדְיָנִ֣ים (oshb:Prov.21.19) and מִדְיָנִ֨ים (oshb:Prov.23.29) and by waw prefix plus accent at וּ֝מִדְיָנִ֗ים (oshb:Prov.18.19); at the skeleton tier the pair is identical at 5 verses, 6 with the prefixed form. The severity turns on whether the row states anything false, and it does not: 'the same pair attested at 25:24 and 26:21 in this part' and 'recurs at 3 non-adjacent verses in this part' are true at the skeleton tier within the writer part, because chapters 25-27 hold exactly those 3 of the 6 sites, and the row nowhere says only. What is defective is the scope and the tier: 'in this part' is workflow register (a writer-part range) that hides the corpus-wide order of a motif the row itself calls recurring, and the unnamed tier leaves the digit 3 reproducible only under that scope or at the byte-identical sub-object; that is a register plus disclosure shortfall on a texture claim the row expressly declines to use as a cluster driver, so nothing load-bearing and no byte-false digit. Under the lane test a true cross-row claim phrased in workflow register is low; medium is downgraded to low. The proposed field repair is endorsed with two qualifications: the 3-site sub-object is byte-identical (ketiv plus fully pointed qere), not merely accent-identical, and the 6-verse object should be stated at the skeleton tier with the waw-prefixed oshb:Prov.18.19 named; deleting 'in this part' from all three fields and mirroring every argued site into boundary_evidence_refs is sound. both_sides_assessed false because the item concerns no seam (a count-object and register item); for completeness the row's edges re-derive clean anyway, oshb:Prov.27.14|oshb:Prov.27.15 and oshb:Prov.27.15|oshb:Prov.27.16 each sharing 0 word-bound skeleton tokens, so no span question is open.

Re-derived from bytes both ways; every digit in the finding re-derives. The definite form is word-bound in exactly 2 verses book-wide (sweep, word-bound skeleton token האדם, verses: Prov.27.19, Prov.27.20) and the two tokens are byte-identical down to the accents, הָ֝אָדָ֗ם (oshb:Prov.27.19) and הָ֝אָדָ֗ם (oshb:Prov.27.20), byte tier; the bare token אדם (skeleton-tier mention) stands in 33 verses (word-bound, verses) and the contiguous skeleton substring in 44 verses / 46 occurrences, of which oshb:Prov.23.31 is the verb for reddening, not the noun, so the substring object is itself blended and the object must be named before any digit is trusted. The row's three comparanda at the same exact-form tier: זָ֭הָב (oshb:Prov.25.11) is word-bound in 4 verses (Prov.11.22, Prov.20.15, Prov.25.11, Prov.25.12; 7 verses for any prefixed form), הָג֣וֹ (oshb:Prov.25.4) in 2 verses (Prov.25.4, Prov.25.5), עָ֭צֵל (oshb:Prov.26.13) in 12 verses plus וְ֝עָצֵ֗ל (oshb:Prov.26.14) in 1, and all three pairs are byte-identical at their seams exactly as the definite form is here. So the row's rejection, 'too generic a subject-term ... unlike the narrower catchwords', is true only if 'the word' means the bare lexeme (33 or 44 verses) and inverts at the tier its own comparanda are measured at, where the form shared here (2 verses, both at this seam) is the narrowest of the four; the row never names the object, carries no digit for any of the four, and observed_substrate_signals writes the bare token 'as' the definite form, which is the count-object blend the finding names. BOTH SIDES of the seam the rival concerns, 27:19|27:20: the closing verse כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם (oshb:Prov.27.19) and the opening verse שְׁא֣וֹל ואבדה וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹ לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְעֵינֵ֥י הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה (oshb:Prov.27.20), both byte tier; governing rule: C5 single-proverb default, a cluster only on named byte-grounded cohesion (catchword chain or pair grouping). A byte-identical form unique to these two adjacent verses is catchword-class evidence of the kind the bar admits, so the rival is live and must be weighed on named objects; against it, each verse's simile is syntactically complete and the shared noun is the generic human term, so the atomic reading remains defensible and the seam does not rest on the defective sentence alone, which is why medium (defective warrant, not alone load-bearing) is confirmed rather than high. The flanking seams are clean either way, oshb:Prov.27.18|oshb:Prov.27.19 and oshb:Prov.27.20|oshb:Prov.27.21 each sharing 0 word-bound skeleton tokens, so a 27:19-20 pair, if the owner ever adopted one, would be cleanly bounded. Adjacent-row coherence: the 27:20 row (M8-Prov-488) rejects the same cluster by cross-reference to this row's warrant, so any repair here must be mirrored there. The proposed field repair (name the objects, give the digits, re-derive the comparison) is endorsed; its onward note that the cluster rival must be re-weighed is correct, and no span change is proposed or ruled, span_ruling n/a.

Re-derived from bytes both ways. The register map the rival's rejection rests on is byte-false at 30:4-5: first-person forms stand at אָנֹכִ֣י (oshb:Prov.30.2), לִֽי (oshb:Prov.30.2), לָמַ֥דְתִּי (oshb:Prov.30.3) and אֵדָֽע (oshb:Prov.30.3) and nowhere in 30:4-6; oshb:Prov.30.4 is a run of מִ֤י (oshb:Prov.30.4) questions closing in the second person, כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע (oshb:Prov.30.4); oshb:Prov.30.5 is third person throughout, מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַֽחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ (oshb:Prov.30.5); oshb:Prov.30.6 is a second-person vetitive to a human hearer, בְּךָ֣ (oshb:Prov.30.6), וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ (oshb:Prov.30.6). So '1st-person confession before God (30:2-5)' is false for two of its four verses, and the device_notes label '1st-to-2nd-person register shift' mislabels the seam, because 30:6 is already second person and the speaker stays first person across it, שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי (oshb:Prov.30.7), מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי (oshb:Prov.30.7), אָמֽוּת (oshb:Prov.30.7). What changes at 30:6|30:7 is the addressee (a human hearer at 30:4 and 30:6; from 30:7 a divine addressee, inferred from מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ (oshb:Prov.30.7) with הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי (oshb:Prov.30.8) and מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה (oshb:Prov.30.9), since no vocative names God) and the form (vetitive warning to numeral petition); all pointed forms byte tier. BOTH SIDES: the closing verse of the preceding unit אַל תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ (oshb:Prov.30.6) and the opening verse of this unit שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת (oshb:Prov.30.7), both byte tier; governing rule for C6: numerical sayings are chunked by the x-of-y function, and the numeral opener שְׁ֭תַּיִם (oshb:Prov.30.7) is verse-initial and the only שתים token in the book (sweep, word-bound skeleton token, 1 verse), with the petuchah at Prov.30.6 (pmarks_Prov.json marks, PE, single witness) as tier-3 corroboration; the seam survives on a tier-1 formula the row already leads with, so the misdescribed register shift is corroboration, not the sole load. Medium is confirmed: a byte-false warrant component, not alone load-bearing. Adjacent-row coherence: the 30:1-6 row (M8-Prov-547) closes on this same seam and its device_notes carry the same 30:2-5 first-person map, so the repair must be mirrored there; this ruling is coherent with the companion item on this row, whose seams are likewise unchanged. The proposed repair is endorsed with two qualifications: 'inside continuous first-person speech' overstates, since 30:4-6 carry no first-person form (the speaker continuity is discourse-level, explicit at 30:2-3 and 30:7-9), and the repaired map must include 30:4's second-person close and mark the divine addressee at 30:7-9 as inferred from content. No span change; span_ruling n/a.

Re-derived from bytes both ways; both chains are byte-true, with one precision on 'heads'. Vetitive chain: the patach-pointed prohibitive particle (distinct from the segol preposition, which stands once in oshb:Prov.30.10 as אֶל (oshb:Prov.30.10) and is not counted) is word-bound in 64 verses book-wide as the bare token and in 18 more as the waw-prefixed form (sweep, accent-stripped word-bound tokens, verses), and in chapter 30 only at oshb:Prov.30.6, oshb:Prov.30.7, oshb:Prov.30.8 and oshb:Prov.30.10, four of the five verses 30:6-10, as אַל תּ֥וֹסְףְּ (oshb:Prov.30.6), אַל תִּמְנַ֥ע (oshb:Prov.30.7), אַל תִּֽתֶּן (oshb:Prov.30.8) and אַל תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן (oshb:Prov.30.10), the particle itself byte-identical at all four; it is verse-initial at 30:6 and 30:10 but clause-initial only at 30:7 (after the atnach) and at 30:8, so 'heads' should read clause-initial for those two. Lest chain: the particle is word-bound in 17 verses book-wide plus 1 waw-prefixed (sweep, skeleton tokens, verses), in chapter 30 only at פֶּן (oshb:Prov.30.6), פֶּ֥ן (oshb:Prov.30.9), וּפֶֽן (oshb:Prov.30.9) and פֶּֽן (oshb:Prov.30.10), a skeleton-tier chain whose forms differ by accent, meteg and prefix exactly as the auditor states. Word-bound skeleton intersections confirm the straddle: oshb:Prov.30.6|oshb:Prov.30.7 shares 1 token (the vetitive), oshb:Prov.30.7|oshb:Prov.30.8 shares 2 (the vetitive and מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי (oshb:Prov.30.7) / מִמֶּ֗נִּי (oshb:Prov.30.8)), oshb:Prov.30.9|oshb:Prov.30.10 shares 1 (the lest-particle), against 0 at oshb:Prov.30.5|oshb:Prov.30.6 and at oshb:Prov.30.10|oshb:Prov.30.11. None of this appears in boundary_rationale, observed_substrate_signals or device_notes, while the row calls 30:7 'distinct in voice and grammar' from what precedes it (30:6 and 30:7 share the vetitive grammar) and calls 30:10 'unrelated' (topically true, formally false: vetitive plus lest is the admonition frame running through 30:6-10). BOTH SIDES at both seams. 30:6|30:7: the closing verse אַל תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ (oshb:Prov.30.6) against the opening verse שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת (oshb:Prov.30.7), byte tier; the numeral opener שְׁ֭תַּיִם (oshb:Prov.30.7), tier-1 under the C6 x-of-y function rule, with the petuchah at Prov.30.6 (pmarks_Prov.json marks, PE, single witness, tier-3) decides the seam over the shared vetitive. 30:9|30:10: the closing verse פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי (oshb:Prov.30.9), byte tier, completes the two-request unit with its paired lest-clauses and carries the petuchah at Prov.30.9 (PE, single witness); the opening verse אַל תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל אדנו אֲדֹנָ֑יו פֶּֽן יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ (oshb:Prov.30.10), byte tier, begins a non-numerical admonition on a new topic, and the דּ֭וֹר (oshb:Prov.30.11) anaphora run of 30:11-14 does not reach it; the function rule and the mark decide the seam over the shared lest-particle. Both seams survive, so medium (defective warrant components and undisclosed straddling devices, not alone load-bearing) is confirmed, ruled coherently with the companion item on this row and with the 30:1-6 and 30:10 rows, whose seams are unchanged. The proposed disclosure repair is endorsed with the clause-initial precision; its onward note of a strengthened 30:1-9 merge rival is recorded but not supported from bytes, because the numeral formula is the collection's ruled unit device and the chains are the generic admonition frame that 30:10 shares as well. No span change; span_ruling n/a.
